items.q: Do I need a NinjaTrader 8 license to use Logic Indicators?
items.a:
No. You do not need to purchase the NinjaTrader 8 Lifetime license to use our tools.

Logic Indicators are independent developments and do not rely on NinjaTrader's Order Flow tools. This means you can use our solutions without buying the platform's official add-ons.

items.q: Is Level 2 (Level II) data required to use the tools?
items.a:
In most cases, no.

The following tools:

- Logic Profile
- Logic Footprint
- Logic Algorithms
- Logic Big Trades
- Logic Analytics

work perfectly using only Level 1 (Level I) data, which is provided by any:

- Live account
- Demo account (10-minute delay after 14 days)
- Prop firm account

The only tools that require Level 2 (Market Depth) data are the Liquidity Maps, since they need order book information to function.

Important: Logic Indicators does not provide market data. Each user must contract and manage their own data provider.

items.q: Do I receive support material to learn how to use the tools?
items.a:
Yes.

When you purchase Logic Indicators you will get access to a complete support package that includes:

- Step-by-step installation manual.
- Configuration guide for each tool.
- Detailed explainer videos.
- Tutorials to take advantage of all features.

Our goal is for you to install, configure, and start using the tools quickly, thanks to our default templates — with a single click you can have fully configured charts.

items.q: What platforms do the tools work on?
items.a:
Currently, Logic Indicators has been developed exclusively for NinjaTrader 8.

All tools are optimized for this platform to offer maximum performance, stability, and execution speed.

There is currently no compatibility with other trading platforms.

items.q: What are the minimum system requirements for my computer?
items.a:
One of the advantages of Logic Indicators is that it does not use Tick Replay, which significantly reduces resource consumption and improves the platform's performance.

As a reference, we recommend meeting NinjaTrader 8's minimum requirements:

- 64-bit 3 GHz processor or higher.
- 16 GB of RAM (or higher recommended for better performance).
- DirectX 10-compatible graphics card or higher.
- Solid State Drive (SSD).
- 64-bit Windows operating system.

If you use multiple screens or run multiple charts simultaneously, more RAM and a more powerful processor will further improve the experience.

items.q: Do the tools use Tick Replay?
items.a:
No.

All Logic Indicators tools have been designed to work without Tick Replay.

This offers important advantages:

- Faster chart loading.
- Lower RAM consumption.
- Better overall NinjaTrader performance.
- Lower processor usage.
- Smoother experience when analyzing the market.

Compared to tools that depend on Tick Replay, our solutions can deliver up to 10x better performance, depending on the hardware, the number of open charts, and the configuration used.
